svg.title: Loadout
svg.desc: Loadout: C and C++, Python, TypeScript, Linux. A weapon wheel on a hotel rooftop at night: C and C++ is a chainsaw (games, DSA, raw speed), Python is a pocket multi-tool (scripts and automation), TypeScript is a pistol with a laser sight and a safety (web apps and tooling), Linux is a crowbar (Sway, terminals, rice).
